payload.title: plan-level contract has no home
payload.body: A plan's payload is its name, the concepts it realizes and its state. The prose a planner writes for a whole plan (its contract, census and findings) has no home in the plan records, so unit specs that cite it point into git history. Should a plan carry a contract as part of its whole state?
